# Groupon

> Groupon is a deals and experiences marketplace offering discounted services, gift cards, and local experiences across dining, beauty, fitness, and lifestyle categories.

Groupon connects consumers with local businesses and national brands through curated deals, gift cards, and membership programs. The platform features expert guides and lifestyle content to help users discover and maximize savings on experiences like dining, wellness, fitness, and beauty services.

## Key Topics

- Gift cards & e-gift cards
- Promotional deals & discounts
- Groupon Select membership
- Laser hair removal
- Fitness & strength training
- Beauty & wellness services
- Experience gifts
- Restaurant deals
- Beginner guides
- Local experiences
- Cash-back rewards
- Promo codes
- Gift guides
- Med spa treatments
- Lifestyle content

- [Article | Groupon Launches Groupon Select](https://www.groupon.com/articles/groupon-launches-groupon-select): Product launch announcement for Groupon Select membership program with benefits
